title: KuCoin announces listing of new Ondo tokenized stocks METAon, TSLAon, QQQon, SPYon, and MUon
why_it_matters: The listings broaden exchange-based access to tokenized U.S. equity and ETF exposure, while highlighting the distinction between price-linked securities tokens and direct share ownership. Regional eligibility and custody arrangements remain important considerations.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

KuCoin announces listing of new Ondo tokenized stocks METAon, TSLAon, QQQon, SPYon, and MUon

KuCoin has scheduled five Ondo-linked equity and ETF tokens for USDT spot trading on November 19, with two opening windows, Solana deposits and withdrawals planned for the following day.
